title: The cozy-night-in debate
old_caption: Aries pitched sledding, string lights and a snowball, then took the snowball to the face. Pisces pitched soup and a sad-dog movie. Turns out one night fits both. Night in or night out?

title: Defining it before the holidays
old_caption: Scorpio rehearsed three openers for the talk, including a slideshow. One talk card and one question did the whole job before the holiday dinner. Did you have the talk early or wing it at dinner?

title: Taking it slow on purpose
old_caption: Everyone else zoomed past on sleds. Virgo and Gemini stopped for a snowflake, a dog and a bench, and still made plans for next week. Slow walkers, where are you?

title: The one who was never seasonal
old_caption: Everyone else got cuffed when it got cold. Scorpio has been bringing Taurus flowers, shade and leaf piles since spring. Some crushes don't check the weather. Who's your every-weather person?

title: Finale: Not cuffed. Chosen.
old_caption: Twelve signs, one very cold month, and every pair still standing under the lights. They swapped the blankets for talk cards, and nobody let go when the snow stopped. Which couple did you root for?

title: Aries arrives two hours early
old_caption: Two hours early, tinsel on everyone, zero chill. Then Aries slowed down for the part that matters: the hello. Who in your family always shows up way too early?

title: Taurus gives the buffet tour
old_caption: Taurus gave a full museum tour of the buffet, then did the unthinkable: handed over the last slice of pie. From a Taurus, that's a love letter. Who gets your last bite?

title: Gemini wrote three family guides
old_caption: Guide A: Dad loves sports. Guide B: never mention sports. Guide C: Dad is a cat person. Dad just said come in, it's cold. Gemini, how many drafts are you on?

title: Cancer already has a stocking
old_caption: Cancer paced the porch rehearsing every worst case. Mom had already stitched a stocking with the date's name on it. Tag the Cancer who worries before every hello.

title: Leo planned an entrance
old_caption: Leo planned the entrance of the year and lost the spotlight to a baby's first steps. Then Leo cheered the loudest. Who's the best supporting star in your family?
